manifest.name: key-value-editor
manifest.title: KeyValueEditor
manifest.description: Edit a list of key and value pairs: message headers, labels, environment variables; rows added with Enter, removed with a button or Mod+Backspace, values in text or base64.
manifest.usage: Use KeyValueEditor where the user writes pairs whose keys they choose: the Composer's headers (keyLabel="Name", valueEncodings=["text", "base64"], repeated names allowed), resource labels (allowDuplicates={false}). It is controlled: pass value and onChange. Enter in a key moves to its value; Enter in a value adds a row below; Mod+Backspace removes the row; focus follows. keySuggestions feeds a datalist. Duplicate keys (when not allowed), a value without a key and a value that is not base64 are marked invalid with a message; the app decides whether to block sending. Show pairs read-only with DescriptionList, or readOnly here to keep the columns.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new rows after every edit, add and remove.

props.name: keySuggestions
props.description: Keys offered while typing a key (a datalist).

props.name: allowDuplicates
props.description: Whether a key may repeat; a repeated key is invalid ("Duplicate key") when false.

props.name: valueEncodings
props.description: With more than one, each row has an encoding Select; a base64 value is checked.

props.name: keyLabel
props.description: The key column's name, used in the header and in each input's label ("Key 1").

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Inputs read-only, no add or remove buttons, the encoding fixed.

props.name: size
props.description: Fluent's size of the inputs and buttons.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: row
slots.description: A key Input, a value Input, the encoding Select and the remove IconButton; data-slot="key-value-editor-row", data-invalid.

states.name: invalid
states.description: A row with a duplicate key, a value without a key or a value that is not base64: the input is aria-invalid and a message in color.danger.fg follows it.

accessibility: The list is a group (role="group") with an accessible name; every input is labelled with its column and row ("Name 2", "Value 2"), and the column header is aria-hidden.
Enter moves from a key to its value and adds a row from a value; Mod+Backspace removes the row (aria-keyshortcuts on the remove button); focus moves to the new row's key or to the previous row.
Invalid inputs are aria-invalid and aria-describedby their message.
The remove buttons are labelled "Remove row n"; the add button has visible text.
